508:t_1:90.en:
$$ロラン$$
「When I think $$グエン$$ hasn't changed a bit, I don't get angry or sad. It just somehow strikes me as funny...」

508:t_1:91.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the heck! I worried for nothing!」

508:t_1:92.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Truth is, I was thinking the same thing.」

508:t_1:94.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Miss $$ソシエ$$ is sure to be furious, and she'll be angry at me for laughing, too.」

508:t_1:96.en:
$$ロラン$$
(But if $$グエン$$ is still the same as ever, then I believe...)

508:t_1:97.en:
$$ロラン$$
($$グエン$$ was always someone who never bowed to any power, no matter how strong...)

508:t_1:98.en:
$$シン$$
「The problem is that those $$クロノ$$ Conservatives have finally made us their direct targets.」

508:t_1:99.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And to think the leader of their strike team is Ensign $$リディ$$...」

508:t_1:100.en:
$$カツ$$
「Do you think he turned on us out of jealousy of $$バナージ$$ and $$ミネバ・ザビ$$?」

508:t_1:101.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I don't think it's that bad, really...」

508:t_1:102.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You never know. When things get this confused, personal feelings can be a big motive.」

508:t_1:103.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「In my case, though, I was acting with the bigger picture in mind.」

508:t_1:104.en:
$$シン$$
(He covered himself before anyone could jump on him!)

508:t_1:105.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
(Isn't it petty stuff like this that keeps him from surpassing the Colonel?)

508:t_1:106.en:
$$カツ$$
「$$バナージ$$, do you have any idea?」

508:t_1:108.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't think about unnecessary things, $$バナージ$$.」

508:t_1:110.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you have no idea, then all you can do is stay as you are.」

508:t_1:111.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And if Ensign $$リディ$$ comes at us as an enemy after that, we can find out what he was thinking then.」

508:t_1:112.en:
$$シン$$
「$$カミーユ$$'s right. We have plenty of other things we need to think about.」

508:t_1:113.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...What about the Colonel's movements?」

508:t_1:114.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's been no contact, and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ doesn't seem to be making any notable moves either.」

508:t_1:115.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Well, at least it doesn't look like he was executed on the spot.」

508:t_1:116.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$ギュネイ$$, you! Jealous of the Colonel again, talking like that...!」

508:t_1:118.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's no use thinking about that either.」

508:t_1:119.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Either way, now that the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives have started moving in the open, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will surely respond.」

508:t_1:120.en:
$$クェス$$
「Then I think $$ハマーン$$ will make a move.」

508:t_1:121.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Why is that, $$クェス$$?」

508:t_1:122.en:
$$クェス$$
「If the Colonel goes back to $$ネオ・ジオン$$, it's sure to have an effect on $$ハマーン$$.」

508:t_1:123.en:
$$カミーユ$$
($$ハマーン・カーン$$, huh...)
